definition: Default WEIGHT_MEAN weighted geometric mean of eight asymmetric-double-sigmoidal desirabilities; QED.py version1.1.0
hydrogens: Chem.RemoveHs default within QED.properties; isotopes, isolated/bridging/hydride/H-only-neighbor/defining-bond-stereo Hs remain
acceptors: sum of 11 query-specific unique match counts, max1000 per query; differs from NumHAcceptors
alerts: 116 distinct patterns; count presence once per pattern, including two disjoint multi-component queries
scope: Empirical drug-likeness score from molecular properties and structural alerts; definition agreement is separate from experimental validation
